messages:
julia-finance: Noticed a weird split on GCP invoice gcp-inv-2024-11-21 — the same order gcp-ord-7722 shows two opposite line items: one charge $11,200 and one credit -$2,800 both labeled 'Reseller split'. Anyone seen this pattern before?
mike-partner-ops: Hmm odd. Could be a partner-level commission reversal that GCP posted separately. Do you have the settlement csv?
gcp-marketplace-bot: Settlement gcp-settle-20241121 processed 2024-11-21T18:02Z. Files: https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/settlements/gcp-settle-20241121 (login required). Affected order: gcp-ord-7722, adj: +11200.00, credit: -2800.00.
nora-ap: AP: hold any payment until we understand. Which partner was routing that order? We should map to partner ledger before booking.
julia-finance: Our mapping shows initial route through CP-12 (EverestChannels). But the credit mentions CP-99 in the remarks. No clear tie.
mike-partner-ops: I'll ping Everest and CP-99 (HarborPartners) to get clarity. Sometimes GCP reassigns routing on settlements when multi-leg reselling is involved.
kevin-revops: From a recognition POV, if net is positive $8,400 that's revenue for the period, but we need to know whether any of it is customer-facing credits. If the -$2,800 credit was already passed to the customer, we shouldn't double-count.\ janet-ops: (bot note) small typo above: 'julia-finance' posted a correction - invoice is gcp-inv-2024-11-20.
anita-cust-success: Customer on gcp-ord-7722 (AcmeSoft) opened a ticket saying they saw a $2,800 credit and then a larger charge on their bank statement. They think we billed them twice.
julia-finance: Important: the GCP invoice here is our vendor invoice, not the customer's billing. But if AcmeSoft got a credit from a partner earlier, this could be them seeing different legs. We need to reconcile ledger vs. customer billing.
mike-partner-ops: Everest replied: "We routed the order originally, but HarborPartners later claimed a sub-resell and GCP split settlement between vendors. We requested clarification from GCP and asked for a single consolidated settlement." Attached snippet: "GCP split settlements for multi-tier resellers can produce offsetting lines."
nora-ap: For bookkeeping: propose we book the net amount as the payable (DR Cost of Sales 6000 $8,400 / CR GCP Payable 2100 $8,400) and tag both lines with settlement id gcp-settle-20241121. If partner later proves additional credit belongs to them, adjust via JE.
kevin-revops: I agree but ask to freeze any customer communication until we reconcile with partners. Also flag as potential OCO (other cost of operations) if we need to reimburse partner.
julia-finance: Action items: (1) Mike to get written confirmation from Everest and Harbor on routing and which party accepts the -$2,800 credit; (2) Nora to prepare provisional net-payable JE for Nov close and hold payment; (3) Kevin to annotate revenue waterfall and mark possible partner reimbursement. We'll close after partner confirmations.
mike-partner-ops: Pinged Harbor and GCP PM. Harbor says they didn't request the credit, asked GCP for evidence. GCP PM acknowledged split and said they will provide settlement mapping by EOD tomorrow.
anita-cust-success: I'll message AcmeSoft to acknowledge receipt of their ticket and say we're investigating; won't commit to any refunds yet.
julia-finance: Thanks all. Keeping AP hold and provisional JE. Update thread when GCP sends the mapping. :white_check_mark:
